from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = ["Weights act as a high-dimensional database.", "Input 'x' activates specific neuron clusters.", "This illumination retrieves stored factual information."]
        self.setup_layout("Mathematical Visualization: The Weights as a Database", lecture_lines)
        
        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Visualize weight matrices as rows/columns. Label with #3498DB.
        weight_matrix = Matrix([[1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0], [0, 0, 1]], v_buff=0.4, h_buff=0.4).set_color("#3498DB")
        self.place_in_area(weight_matrix, 'B4', 'D6', scale_factor=0.6)
        weight_label = Text("Weight Matrix W", font_size=18, color="#3498DB").scale(0.7) # Apply B020
        self.place_at_grid(weight_label, 'A4', scale_factor=0.9)
        weight_label.next_to(weight_matrix, UP)
        
        self.play(Create(weight_matrix), Write(weight_label))
        self.lecture[0].set_color("#3498DB")
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        # Show projection mapping input space to storage [Asset: /scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/database.svg]. Color #E74C3C.
        db_icon = SVGMobject("/scratch/pawsey1357/jthen/Code2Video/assets/icon/database.svg", color="#E74C3C")

        projection_line = DashedLine(input_vec.get_end(), weight_matrix.get_left(), color="#E74C3C")
        
        self.play(GrowArrow(input_vec), FadeIn(db_icon), Create(projection_line))
        self.lecture[1].set_color("#E74C3C")
        self.wait(1)

        self.play(FadeIn(activation), GrowArrow(retrieval_arrow))
        self.lecture[2].set_color("#2ECC71")
        self.wait(2)
